en.headline: Bar calls solicitor senior-counsel proposal premature
en.dek: The Law Society wants eligible solicitors to be able to take silk; the Bar Association says few solicitor advocates use higher court rights and the debate is academic.
body: The Hong Kong Bar Association has described as premature and largely academic a Law Society proposal to amend the Legal Practitioners Ordinance so that suitably qualified solicitors can be appointed senior counsel.

The Law Society, which represents about 14,000 solicitors, told the Legislative Council that solicitors who demonstrate outstanding achievement, professional standing and experience should be eligible for the rank now conferred by the Chief Justice after consulting the Bar chairman and the Law Society president. It said the change would encourage more solicitors to develop advocacy work as courts face a heavier caseload, and that it did not intend to weaken the standing of existing senior counsel. The society cited England and Wales, where 66 of 231 solicitor applicants have been appointed King's Counsel since 1995, and Ireland, where the title has been open to solicitors since 2020.

The Bar Association, responding to enquiries, said Hong Kong already has about 100 solicitor advocates with higher rights of audience, but most have not exercised that privilege in the past two years. A review of judgments from the start of 2024 to the end of 2025 found fewer than 15 cases in which a solicitor advocate appeared in open court as lead or sole advocate, the association said.

The Bar said limited use of those rights reflects the size of the local market, the dominance of small and medium firms, and firms' reluctance to instruct advocates from rival practices. It also pointed to court rulings that barristers must remain independently instructed and cannot practise in partnership, unlike solicitor advocates who may be partners or employees of a firm and can be barred from a case by a colleague's conflict. On that basis, the association said, the question of whether solicitors should be eligible for silk remains premature.

zh.headline: 大律師公會指事務律師任資深大律師屬過早
zh.dek: 律師會向立法會倡修例，讓合資格事務律師可獲委任資深大律師；大律師公會指訟辯律師較少行使出庭權，有關討論仍屬學術層面。
body: 香港大律師公會形容，律師會建議修訂《法律執業者條例》，讓具備適當資格的事務律師亦可獲委任為資深大律師，屬過早而且很大程度上仍是學術討論。

代表近14,000名會員的香港律師會向立法會提交書面意見，建議具備卓越成就、專業地位、法律專長及經驗的事務律師，亦可獲終審法院首席法官委任為資深大律師。現行制度下，首席法官須先諮詢大律師公會執委會主席及律師會會長。律師會指法院案件量持續增加，修例可鼓勵更多事務律師發展訟辯，並強調無意削弱現有資深大律師地位。意見書引用英格蘭及威爾斯自1995年以來231名申請人中有66人獲委任御用大律師，以及愛爾蘭自2020年起已有48名律師獲委任同類名衔。
大律師公會回覆查詢時表示，本港約有100名具較高級法院出庭發言權的訟辯律師，但過去兩年大多數未有行使該權利。公會指，檢視2024年初至2025年底的判詞，訟辯律師以主導或單獨出庭身分在公開法庭行使該權利的案件少於15宗。
公會認為，使用率偏低與本地市場規模、中小型律師行佔多數，以及律師行不願延聘競爭對手的訟辯律師有關。公會並引用法庭判詞指出，大律師必須經律師轉介、保持獨立，不得合夥執業；訟辯律師則可在律師行合夥或受僱，一旦行內出現利益衝突便可能無法代表當事人。基於現況，公會認為事務律師應否獲委任資深大律師的討論仍屬過早。
